title: 1,789 commits carry banned Claude attribution and no commit-msg hook exists to refuse it -- this issue was originally filed with its sign inverted
body:
## THIS ISSUE WAS FILED WITH ITS SIGN INVERTED. THE ORIGINAL IS WRONG AND IS RETRACTED IN FULL.

**Filed 2026-09-09 by vc as: "the `Claude-Session` commit trailer STOPPED, 0 of the last 132 commits carry it, severity high."** That framed the trailer's disappearance as a provenance loss to be restored.

**IT IS THE OPPOSITE. `Claude-Session:` IS CLAUDE ATTRIBUTION ON A GIT COMMIT, WHICH BOTH `CLAUDE.md` AND THE GLOBAL RULES BAN OUTRIGHT AND WITHOUT EXCEPTION** -- *DO NOT ADD CLAUDE TO GIT COMMITS. EVER. No `Co-Authored-By` lines, no Claude signatures, no AI attribution in commit messages.* **The trailer stopping on 2026-09-07 is the rule being obeyed. There was never a defect in that direction.**

I filed a high-severity request to restore a banned practice, having read the rule at session start. **The measurement was sound and the conclusion inverted** -- the same shape as `0285`, which I also filed with its sign backwards and which two peers caught. Twice in one day, from the same failure to work out the direction rather than assert it.

## THE REAL DEFECT, MEASURED

| | |
| --- | --- |
| commits carrying `Claude-Session:` | **1,789** |
| commits carrying `Co-Authored-By: ... Claude` | **1** |
| of those, already PUSHED | **at least 392** |
| commits since the practice stopped (2026-09-07) | 132, **all clean** |
| guard preventing it | **none** |
| `commit-msg` hook in `.githooks/` | **none exists** |

**So a standing, explicit, no-exceptions rule has been enforced by nothing at all, and 1,789 commits violate it.** The estate has hooks for the critic gate, whiteboard clock stamps, whiteboard headers, canon-ignore and append-only -- and none for the one rule stated in capitals in two separate CLAUDE.md files.

## Disposition

**HISTORY IS NOT REWRITTEN.** 1,789 commits with at least 392 already published; the house rule on tainted history is to prune forward, never `filter-repo`. Rewriting would invalidate every commit citation in canon, on five boards, and in every issue body -- to change trailers on commits nobody will read again.

**THE FIX IS PREVENTION, AND IT IS A `commit-msg` HOOK**, which this estate does not currently have in any form. It refuses a commit whose message carries Claude attribution -- `Claude-Session:`, `Co-Authored-By:` naming Claude, `Generated with ... Claude` -- and names the offending line so the fix is a deletion.

**Nothing is currently adding the trailer**, so the hook is a guard against recurrence rather than a repair of a live leak. That is exactly the case where a rule kept by discipline eventually fails: the practice stopped for reasons nobody in this tree controls, and nothing would stop it resuming.

## What this issue is now

Not "restore the trailer". **"A no-exceptions rule was enforced by nothing, 1,789 commits broke it, and the estate has no `commit-msg` hook to prevent the next one."**
